exposure: Registration of a pregnant woman in the maternity hospital at 36th-37th weeks gestation
risk the development of hemolytic disease in the fetus and the newborn
Pregnancies with a defined specific risk
Registration of a pregnant woman in the maternity hospital
outcome: Implementation rate of the new health service
cohort: 2,271 women who gave birth at Olomouc University Hospital in 2022
finding: Implementation of the new health service, which involved registering pregnant women in the maternity hospital at 36-37 weeks gestation, was successful in identifying specific pregnancy risks and determining a pregnancy termination strategy for the majority of women.
mod_finding: The study found that the pregnancy termination strategy was determined by spontaneous vaginal delivery in 63.4% of women, pre-induction of vaginal delivery in 18%, and cesarean section in 14.2%.
